scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm --filter @dsm/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @dsm/desktop-runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter desktop typecheck && pnpm --filter local-unlock typecheck
scripts.package: pnpm run check:preset && pnpm --filter desktop package
scripts.make: pnpm run check:preset && pnpm --filter desktop make
scripts.package:mac: pnpm run check:preset && pnpm --filter desktop package:mac
scripts.make:mac: pnpm run check:preset && pnpm --filter desktop make:mac
scripts.package:win: pnpm run check:preset && pnpm --filter desktop package:win
scripts.make:win: pnpm run check:preset && pnpm --filter desktop make:win
